title: International RSE Survey 2018
text:
Survey overview
This book presents the 2018 survey independently, using the questions and answer options stored in that year’s export.
Source records: 997
Respondents included: 997
Question groups discovered: 74
This export has no submitdate_0 field, so all 997 rows are included.
No cross-year harmonisation is applied.
